name: uemcp-tool-surface-audit
description: Safety classification for the public UEMCP MCP tools and Unreal bridge commands.

uemcp_ping.recommended_use: First reachability check for the Python MCP server and Unreal bridge.

get_editor_status.recommended_use: Read editor identity, project path, map, PIE, and slow-task state before any deeper action.

get_editor_readiness.recommended_use: Preflight readiness gate before automation or compatibility checks.

diagnose_editor_automation_readiness.recommended_use: Compact diagnostic when readiness is blocked or before running automation.

get_observability_recent_events.recommended_use: Read in-process observability history without contacting Unreal.

summarize_observability_state.recommended_use: Summarize the latest actionable observability state for handoff or triage.

get_output_log.recommended_use: Read a bounded Unreal output-log tail with optional filters.

get_level_snapshot.recommended_use: Read a bounded actor and component snapshot from the current editor world.

get_pie_runtime_snapshot.recommended_use: Read a bounded actor and component snapshot from an active PIE runtime world without relaxing editor automation readiness gates.

asset_search.recommended_use: Search Asset Registry metadata without loading or mutating assets.

asset_dependencies.recommended_use: Read hard and soft dependency metadata for one asset package.

asset_referencers.recommended_use: Read hard and soft referencer metadata for one asset package.

asset_intake_snapshot.recommended_use: Capture read-only Asset Registry inventory for one or more roots before and after interactive asset acquisition.

asset_intake_diff.recommended_use: Compare two asset intake snapshots and report added, removed, changed, and optionally unchanged assets.

asset_intake_write_manifest.recommended_use: Write a project-owned JSON manifest under Tools/UEMCP/asset-intake for a reviewed asset intake diff.

asset_import_from_disk.recommended_use: Import local source files through Unreal Editor import tasks after an explicit dry-run review.

asset_organize_plan.recommended_use: Validate an exact-path asset organization operation list before mutating packages.

asset_rename.recommended_use: Rename one exact Unreal asset package through editor-backed asset APIs.

asset_move.recommended_use: Move one exact Unreal asset package to an exact destination package path.

asset_duplicate.recommended_use: Duplicate one exact Unreal asset package to an exact destination package path.

asset_delete.recommended_use: Delete one exact Unreal asset package through editor-backed asset APIs after dry-run review.

asset_save_packages.recommended_use: Save explicit asset packages through the editor asset subsystem.

asset_fixup_redirectors.recommended_use: List or fix redirectors under explicit /Game roots through AssetTools.

asset_prepare_for_level.recommended_use: Load one exact asset and report placement readiness fields such as bounds, collision, material slots, Nanite, and Blueprint actor class.

asset_create_blueprint_wrapper.recommended_use: Create a placement-ready Blueprint wrapper for a StaticMesh at an explicit target package path.

asset_place_in_level_plan.recommended_use: Validate a map-placement plan before mutating the editor level.

asset_place_in_level.recommended_use: Place StaticMesh or Actor Blueprint assets into the current editor level with explicit transforms and save evidence.

asset_validate_level_placements.recommended_use: Validate expected placed actor names or labels in the current editor level.

blueprint_query.recommended_use: Inspect Blueprint identity, status, variables, and components without mutating it.

list_automation_tests.recommended_use: List automation tests by optional dot-path prefix.

run_automation_test.recommended_use: Run one exact Unreal automation test only after readiness is proven.

run_profile_automation_tests.recommended_use: Run a bounded project profile automation batch with compact evidence.

run_project_compatibility_gates.recommended_use: Run profile-declared compatibility sentinels against the live editor.

get_project_context.recommended_use: Read the active project profile and profile source.

get_failstate_context.recommended_use: Compatibility alias for get_project_context; keep new agents on the neutral tool name.

get_actors_in_level.recommended_use: Legacy actor listing; prefer get_level_snapshot for bounded evidence.

find_actors_by_name.recommended_use: Find actors by name pattern in the current level.

get_actor_properties.recommended_use: Read one actor's bounded reflected properties; request private/transient/object-path expansion only when explicitly needed.

spawn_actor.recommended_use: Spawn a basic actor in the loaded editor world; use only for explicit level-edit tasks.

delete_actor.recommended_use: Delete a named actor from the loaded editor world after snapshot confirmation.

set_actor_transform.recommended_use: Move, rotate, or scale a named actor after confirming the target map and actor.

set_actor_property.recommended_use: Set a property on a named actor after confirming the actor and property contract.

spawn_blueprint_actor.recommended_use: Spawn a Blueprint actor into the level; verify the asset path and map first.

save_current_level.recommended_use: Persist current editor-level changes through Unreal's editor save API after snapshot validation.

create_blueprint.recommended_use: Create a Blueprint asset only in explicit asset-authoring workflows.

add_component_to_blueprint.recommended_use: Mutate a Blueprint asset by adding a component; compile and query afterward.

set_static_mesh_properties.recommended_use: Set StaticMeshComponent mesh properties on a Blueprint asset.

set_component_property.recommended_use: Set a component property on a Blueprint asset after proving the component exists.

set_physics_properties.recommended_use: Set physics properties on a Blueprint component.

compile_blueprint.recommended_use: Compile a Blueprint after intentional Blueprint asset edits.

set_blueprint_property.recommended_use: Set a Blueprint class default property after confirming the property name and value.

add_blueprint_event_node.recommended_use: Add an event node to a Blueprint graph in explicit graph-authoring workflows.

add_blueprint_input_action_node.recommended_use: Add an input action node to a Blueprint graph after input mapping is confirmed.

add_blueprint_function_node.recommended_use: Add a function-call node to a Blueprint graph.

connect_blueprint_nodes.recommended_use: Connect Blueprint graph nodes only after the exact node IDs are known.

add_blueprint_variable.recommended_use: Add a Blueprint variable in an explicit graph or asset-authoring workflow.

add_blueprint_get_self_component_referen.recommended_use: Add a component reference node to a Blueprint graph.

add_blueprint_self_reference.recommended_use: Add a self-reference node to a Blueprint graph.

find_blueprint_nodes.recommended_use: Read Blueprint graph node IDs before making graph edits.

create_input_mapping.recommended_use: Mutate project input configuration only when input setup is the explicit task.

create_umg_widget_blueprint.recommended_use: Create a UMG Widget Blueprint asset in explicit UI-authoring workflows.

add_text_block_to_widget.recommended_use: Mutate a Widget Blueprint by adding a text block.

add_button_to_widget.recommended_use: Mutate a Widget Blueprint by adding a button.

bind_widget_event.recommended_use: Bind a Widget Blueprint event in explicit UI-authoring workflows.

add_widget_to_viewport.recommended_use: Add a widget instance to the game viewport for explicit UI preview tasks.

set_text_block_binding.recommended_use: Set a text binding on a Widget Blueprint after confirming the target widget.

ping.recommended_use: Unreal bridge command used internally by uemcp_ping.

create_actor.recommended_use: Legacy bridge alias for spawning an actor; use the registered spawn_actor MCP tool instead.

focus_viewport.recommended_use: Bridge-only viewport camera command; not currently exposed as an MCP tool.

take_screenshot.recommended_use: Bridge-only screenshot command that writes a PNG file; not currently exposed as an MCP tool.

set_pawn_properties.recommended_use: Bridge-only legacy Blueprint property helper; prefer explicit registered property tools.

add_blueprint_get_component_node.recommended_use: Bridge-only legacy component-node command; prefer registered graph tools.

level_list_maps.recommended_use: List map packages under exact /Game roots before opening or constructing levels.

level_create.recommended_use: Create a new editor-owned map package after dirty-map preflight and explicit user intent.

level_open.recommended_use: Open one exact map package through Unreal Editor loading APIs after dirty-map preflight.

level_save.recommended_use: Save the current editor map and map-related packages with structured dirty-package evidence.

level_construction_plan.recommended_use: Validate a declarative level construction operation list before editor mutation.

level_apply_construction_plan.recommended_use: Apply a validated exact-actor level construction plan through editor-owned APIs.

level_validate_construction.recommended_use: Validate expected exact actors, classes, folders, tags, and transforms in the current editor map.
